notes: A single chained vision pipeline. dependent_stages=3: the per-frame foreground masks come from running the provided distilled-SAM checkpoint on the CPU (C-7a6); those masks feed the background-subtracted bounding tracking (C-2a5) and the vertical-motion takeoff/landing detection (C-9d0), whose takeoff frame selects the reference frame that per-cell segmentation uses; the refined per-cell polylines (C-6d8) are then re-embedded into the schema-preserving out.csv (C-b2). rounding: OCR (C-be7) and the C PNG decoder (C-14b) are independent leaf stages. tool_breadth=2: numpy/torch/cv2 for the pipeline plus a compiled C/libpng decoder and a tesseract OCR step. reasoning_depth=3: the per-cell masks must be normalised into a single connected, mutually disjoint, non-trivial polygon (not the trivial prompt rectangle), which requires understanding contour extraction/polygon simplification and cell-local coordinate frames; and the takeoff/landing heuristic must be derived from the tracked vertical trajectory. hidden_case_generalization=3: the same pipeline.py/cdecode must run correctly on three hidden clips with different frame counts, image sizes, label phrases, jump windows and cell grids. adversarial_inputs=2: empty (background-only) cells must yield empty polys, and the verifier rejects a pipeline that merely echoes the prompt rectangle or hardcodes a clip. quantitative_correctness=2: bbox/event/mask checks use tolerances (IoU and frame-slop) rather than exact equality where noise could differ.
